board: Pennsylvania State Board of Accountancy (Department of State)

cycle.label: Reporting period
cycle.note: Licenses expire December 31 of odd-numbered years; CPE runs January 1 of the even year to December 31 of the odd year.

requirements.label: Self-study
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. No more than 40 hours of individual (self) study count per reporting period, including when combined with authorship (§ 11.64(2)(iv)). Nano counts as self-study. We use each course's delivery format — set it on each course.

requirements.label: Accounting & attest
requirements.note: 24 hours in accounting and attest if you participate in attest activity (§ 11.63(a)(1)). If you supervise attest services and sign the report, § 11.23a may require additional CPE.

newLicensee.note: Passed the CPA exam during this reporting period? You're exempt from CPE for your first renewal (Department of State renewal guidance; § 11.62(a) applies the same exemption to the initial license).

licenseDateHint: Pennsylvania licenses expire December 31 of odd-numbered years (e.g. 12/31/2027).
issueDateHint: Enter the date you passed the CPA exam — if it's in this reporting period, no CPE is due for your first renewal.
limitsNotTracked: Instruction: max 40 hours (3 CPE per 50 minutes presented).
Authorship: 20 per publication, 40 total (shares the 40-hour self-study cap).
toVerify: First-renewal exemption: § 11.62(a) exempts exam-passers from CPE for the initial license application; the Department of State's renewal page extends it to the first renewal. Keyed to the date entered as the issue date.
Mapping of NASBA fields to the § 11.63 subject areas is for display only (only A&A for attest and ethics have minimums).
Both Regulatory and Behavioral Ethics count toward the 4 professional ethics hours.
Nano counted as individual study toward the § 11.64 40-hour cap; blended isn't.
recordRetention: Keep certificates for 5 years after each program (§ 11.68(b)).
